capabilities: capture selected settings, plugins and snippets into a portable store
apply captured items explicitly on another device
encrypt shared fields with a per-device passphrase
push and pull the store to git or another-vault remotes
install, update or enable plugins during Apply
disambiguation: Not a note-sync tool; it distributes settings and plugin configs, riding whatever note sync you already use to carry the store.
extras: Full user guide, changelog, upgrade notes and architecture docs live outside the README; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Git remotes are the plugin's only network access, desktop-only, and tokens are stored in Obsidian's keychain.
problem: Obsidian keeps settings per device and per vault, with no built-in way to selectively move configuration items between them.

relations.evidence: The data rides your existing note sync (remotely-save, Obsidian Sync, iCloud…)
